entities.summary: June Democracy Movement and Olympics, a transformative movement in South Korea (1987–1993). Emerged from June 29 Declaration and June Democracy Movement forces democratic concessions. Catalyzed Seoul hosts the Olympic Games — South Korea's coming-out party to the world.
